bibl.title: Digitizing Medical Papyri in Question-and-Answer Format.
bibl.seg: Nicola Reggiani, Digitizing Medical Papyri in Question-and-Answer Format.
Michiel Meeusen (ed.), Ancient Greek Medicine in Questions and Answers. Diagnostics, Didactics, Dialectics (Leiden - Boston, 2020) pp. 181-212.
bibl.note: Presents a general overview of the Greek medical papyri in question-and-answer format, focusing in particular on their layout and on the graphical strategies deployed by the ancient scribes in highlighting the main articulations of the texts.
